title: Doc workbench persistent tree with move and destination picker
intent: Make the docs workbench feel like a navigable workspace, not a flat document list, by supporting nested page movement, destination selection, breadcrumbs, and scoped create actions.
acceptance: User can move a document under another document or to root without typing IDs.
Move preview shows source path, destination path, and affected children before commit.
Tree preserves expanded state, selected document, and scroll position after move/create/delete.
Server rejects cycles and invalid parent moves with user-visible messages.
anti_patterns: Flat table-only docs UI
Move actions hidden in raw JSON forms
Client-only tree mutation without service validation
Losing selection after every tree refresh
interactions: Drag document in sidebar to new parent.
Open destination picker from row menu.
Create child from parent row plus button.
Undo failed move restores previous tree state.
critique_focus: Check whether page hierarchy is a first-class workbench interaction or only incidental data on docs routes.
manual_simulation: Start on /docs, expand a nested tree, move a page to a new parent, reload, verify selected page and hierarchy remain correct.
incentive: Docs are the first workflow input; hierarchy friction blocks W1 freeform intake.

title: Slash command menu parity for workflow documents
intent: Expand the Svelte Tiptap slash menu into a workflow-grade insert surface covering Docmost-style content blocks and Fulcrum-specific planning/context blocks.
acceptance: Slash menu contains grouped search results for text, task list, media, attachments, callout, table, math, mermaid, embed, wikilink, subpage, context source, and artifact reference.
Each item has keyboard navigation, icon, title, description, and search terms.
Menu insertion preserves cursor position and can be dismissed without changing content.
Workflow-specific blocks store structured metadata that survives save/load/render.
anti_patterns: Single ungrouped command list
Hard-coded blocks that serialize only as markdown text
Mouse-only slash menu
Adding AI-only blocks before manual docs parity works
interactions: Type slash at start of line.
Filter by attachment, task, artifact, context, mermaid, or table.
Use arrow keys and Enter to insert.
Undo inserted block with editor history.
critique_focus: Verify block menu helps users compose planning docs and knowledge pages without leaving the editor.
manual_simulation: Create a new doc, insert 10 block types via slash search using only keyboard, save, reopen, and verify rendered output.
incentive: Richer document capture improves downstream planning context and reduces bespoke forms.

title: Fixed editor toolbar with workflow-safe controls
intent: Provide a stable Docmost-style toolbar for common formatting and insert actions so users do not depend solely on slash commands.
acceptance: Toolbar exposes block type, inline marks, lists, links, alignment, media, quick inserts, more inserts, and undo/redo.
Toolbar state reflects current selection and disables invalid actions.
Toolbar remains reachable on long documents without covering content.
Doc type presets can hide irrelevant controls while preserving core editing.
anti_patterns: Toolbar that duplicates all slash items without grouping
Controls that change layout while typing
Invisible disabled states
Formatting state tracked outside editor selection
interactions: Select text and toggle marks.
Insert media from toolbar.
Undo/redo using toolbar buttons.
Switch document type and verify toolbar preset changes.
critique_focus: Assess whether editing feels efficient for repeated work sessions, not just demo content creation.
manual_simulation: Edit a long planning doc for five minutes using toolbar controls only; verify no content is obscured or lost.
incentive: Visible controls reduce discoverability debt for human operators.

title: Inline attachment nodes backed by document attachment API
intent: Unify document attachments and editor media so uploads appear as durable inline nodes and as a document attachment inventory.
acceptance: User can upload from editor slash menu, toolbar, or document attachment panel.
Uploaded files create attachment metadata, checksum, size, MIME type, and download URL.
Inline attachment node and attachments list reference the same record.
Deleting an attachment warns when it is still referenced inline.
anti_patterns: Separate editor uploads and doc attachment uploads
Base64 file bodies in document JSON
Download links without authorization checks
Attachment rows that cannot be traced to document content
interactions: Upload PDF from slash menu.
Insert same attachment into body.
Open attachment list and download.
Attempt delete while inline reference exists.
critique_focus: Look for drift between artifact storage, document attachments, and editor nodes.
manual_simulation: Attach a file, embed it in the doc body, reload, download it, then delete or replace it and verify behavior.
incentive: Attachments are core to docs as planning context and approval evidence.

title: Bridge document attachments to Fulcrum artifact lifecycle
intent: Allow a document attachment to be promoted to an artifact, linked to a run/task/review, and governed by artifact retention without duplicating binary storage.
acceptance: Attachment detail exposes promote-to-artifact action when user has permission.
Promoted artifact keeps source document ID, attachment ID, checksum, and lifecycle state.
Artifact lifecycle changes are visible from document attachment detail.
Retention/deletion policy warns when artifact and document share storage.
anti_patterns: Copying the same file into unrelated stores
Artifact lifecycle hidden from document users
Promotion without trace metadata
Deleting promoted attachments silently breaks artifacts
interactions: Open document attachment menu.
Promote attachment to artifact.
Accept or reject artifact in artifact surface.
Return to doc and inspect linked lifecycle.
critique_focus: Ensure knowledge capture and execution evidence share one traceable storage model.
manual_simulation: Upload requirements PDF to a doc, promote it to artifact, accept it, then verify both doc and artifact pages show the relationship.
incentive: Connects W1 docs, W4 artifacts, W11 review, and W13 evidence generation.

title: Docmost-style active and resolved comment tabs
intent: Make comments actionable by separating active review discussion from resolved history and supporting replies, mentions, anchors, and resolve workflows.
acceptance: Comment panel has Active and Resolved tabs with counts.
Top-level comments support one-level replies and resolve/unresolve actions.
Comment anchors can target a selected range or block when available.
Mentioned users and watchers receive traceable notification events.
anti_patterns: Single flat comment list
Resolved comments disappearing permanently
Comments detached from document version context
No permission distinction between view and comment
interactions: Select text and comment.
Reply to comment.
Resolve and switch to resolved tab.
Mention a user and inspect event/notification trace.
critique_focus: Verify comments serve review and planning loops, not just generic notes.
manual_simulation: Create two comments, reply to one, resolve it, reload, and confirm active/resolved counts and anchors.
incentive: Comment quality directly affects W5 and W12 feedback loops.

title: Inline selection comments with visible document marks
intent: Preserve comment context inside the document body by marking annotated text and syncing comment selection state with the side panel.
acceptance: Selecting text exposes add-comment affordance.
Saved comment stores selection text, document position metadata, and version ID.
Clicking a comment scrolls to and highlights the annotated text.
If content moves, comment shows stale/moved state rather than silently pointing to wrong text.
anti_patterns: Only page-level comments
Comment anchors as unvalidated arbitrary JSON
Highlights that disappear after reload
Anchors that survive edits by accident only
interactions: Select a sentence, create comment, edit nearby text, reload, click comment.
Resolve comment and verify mark style changes.
Open version history to see version captured at comment time.
critique_focus: Check whether document review can be precise enough for UAT/code-review-style feedback.
manual_simulation: Annotate three ranges, edit the document between them, and verify each comment either remains correct or flags drift.
incentive: Precise annotations reduce ambiguous agent feedback and rework.

title: Page details sidebar with backlink counts and navigation
intent: Expose graph context around each document so users can understand what references a page before editing or deleting it.
acceptance: Document detail shows backlink count split by direct links and mentions where data permits.
Backlinks open in a modal or sidebar with source title, snippet, scope, and last updated time.
Backlink list can be filtered by project/task/run context.
Delete or archive action warns when backlinks exist.
anti_patterns: Backlinks visible only when non-empty without discoverability
Backlinks as raw IDs
No warning before deleting referenced docs
Search-only graph navigation
interactions: Create wikilink from one doc to another.
Open target doc details and view backlink.
Filter backlinks to project context.
Try to archive target doc and see warning.
critique_focus: Determine whether docs form a usable knowledge graph or isolated pages.
manual_simulation: Create three linked docs, navigate via backlinks, then edit a title and verify backlink labels update.
incentive: Graph context makes docs dependable planning inputs.

title: Visual history diff with restore guardrails
intent: Upgrade document history from a list of versions to a readable diff-and-restore workflow modeled on Docmost history editor behavior.
acceptance: History view shows selected version metadata, contributor, and rendered diff.
Added and removed text/blocks use distinct accessible styling.
Restore requires confirmation and creates a new version rather than overwriting history.
Diff handles attachments and custom nodes with stable placeholders.
anti_patterns: Raw JSON diff as primary UI
Restore that mutates old version in place
Diff that drops custom nodes
No contributor or timestamp context
interactions: Edit document twice, open history, compare versions, restore older version, inspect new latest version.
Diff a version with attachment node and table node.
critique_focus: Verify history supports trust and recovery during continuous update loops.
manual_simulation: Make conflicting edits, restore earlier version, and confirm history remains complete and understandable.
incentive: W14 continuous update loop needs safe recovery from bad edits.

title: Version metadata captures planning and run context
intent: Attach workflow context to document versions so users can tell whether an edit came from manual writing, ACP planning, agent update, review feedback, or artifact import.
acceptance: Each version stores actor, source surface, source workflow event, optional run/task/review/artifact IDs, and summary.
History UI can filter versions by manual, agent, import, restore, or review feedback.
Automated edits include source prompt or update intent reference.
Version API remains usable for docs without workflow context.
anti_patterns: Versions as timestamp-only snapshots
Agent edits indistinguishable from human edits
Embedding workflow metadata only in markdown body
Breaking existing version queries
interactions: Create manual edit, planning-context edit, and continuous-update edit.
Open history and filter by source.
Click version source to navigate to run/review/task where applicable.
critique_focus: Check provenance clarity for mixed human-agent document changes.
manual_simulation: Trigger one manual and one continuous update, then verify history explains who/what changed the doc.
incentive: Prevents trust loss when agents modify knowledge assets.

title: Template gallery with destination picker and preview
intent: Move templates from configuration management into a creation workflow where users can preview, choose destination, and instantiate structured documents.
acceptance: New document flow can start from blank or template gallery.
Template preview shows rendered body, frontmatter requirements, and intended doc type.
Use-template flow lets user choose project/scope/parent destination before creation.
Instantiated document records template ID and allows later drift comparison.
anti_patterns: Templates available only in settings/admin page
Template body preview as plain textarea only
Creating template output at wrong root by default
No trace from document back to template
interactions: Open New Doc, choose template, preview it, pick destination, create, then inspect source template metadata.
critique_focus: Assess whether templates accelerate repeated Fulcrum workflows rather than only storing snippets.
manual_simulation: Create a project decision template, instantiate under a project, and verify frontmatter plus tree placement.
incentive: Templates increase consistency of planning and review documents.

title: Frontmatter form as workflow metadata editor
intent: Treat frontmatter as structured workflow metadata with validation, defaults, and human-readable controls rather than a hidden YAML escape hatch.
acceptance: Document type controls required and optional frontmatter fields.
Form mode and YAML mode round-trip without losing unknown fields.
Validation errors map to exact fields and block invalid save.
Workflow fields can link to project, task, run, review, artifact, or source reference.
anti_patterns: YAML-only metadata editing
Silent dropping of unknown metadata
Saving invalid frontmatter as strings
Duplicating workflow links in body text only
interactions: Switch from form to YAML and back.
Add task link, invalid date, and unknown field.
Save and inspect validation behavior.
critique_focus: Verify metadata is precise enough for deterministic retrieval and workflow linkage.
manual_simulation: Create a decision doc with project/task/status/frontmatter, intentionally break one field, and confirm error recovery.
incentive: Structured metadata avoids model/RAG dependency for knowledge retrieval.

title: Doc search with snippets, filters, and graph actions
intent: Bring Docmost search ergonomics into Fulcrum docs with scoped filters, snippets, and actions that turn search results into context for planning.
acceptance: Search results include title, snippet/highlight, scope, doc type, updated time, and graph counts.
Filters support project, task, run, document type, owner, and attachment presence.
Result actions include open, add to planning context, copy link, and reveal in tree.
Search respects document permissions and excludes unauthorized content.
anti_patterns: Search box that only filters current page list client-side
No snippets or ranking explanation
Search results detached from context-building workflow
Permission filtering after leaking titles
interactions: Search across docs, filter to project, add two results to planning context, reveal one in tree.
critique_focus: Check whether search helps users assemble work context, not merely find text.
manual_simulation: Create docs across two projects, search common term, verify filters and add-to-context behavior.
incentive: Docs become useful when retrieval is fast, scoped, and deterministic.

title: Attachment-aware document search indexing
intent: Index attachment metadata and extracted text where available so uploaded evidence can participate in document retrieval and planning context.
acceptance: Attachment filename, MIME type, size, checksum, and optional extracted text are indexed.
Document search can filter has:attachment and attachment type.
Search result shows attachment hit separately from body hit.
Index update occurs on attachment upload/delete and document update.
anti_patterns: Attachment search only by exact filename in UI
Indexing binary blobs directly
Search index stale after upload/delete
Mixing artifact and attachment hits without type labels
interactions: Upload PDF and image, search filename and extracted phrase, filter to attachments, open source doc.
critique_focus: Determine whether evidence files are retrievable as first-class knowledge assets.
manual_simulation: Attach two files, trigger index, search for names and metadata, then delete one and verify disappearance.
incentive: Planning often starts from attached specs, logs, screenshots, and exports.

title: Presence and cursor overlay with conflict-safe save semantics
intent: Make real-time collaboration visible and safe by connecting presence, cursor state, connection health, and save status in the document editor.
acceptance: Editor shows connected users, cursor positions, connection state, and last saved state.
Offline or disconnected edits show a clear risk state and retry path.
Concurrent edits produce version history entries with contributor context.
Feature flag off state degrades to single-user save without dead controls.
anti_patterns: Presence avatars without actual collaboration state
Silent fallback that loses edits
Realtime-only editor with no non-realtime path
Cursor overlays that obscure text
interactions: Open same doc in two sessions, edit concurrently, disconnect one, reconnect, inspect history.
critique_focus: Verify collaboration builds trust rather than adding visual noise.
manual_simulation: Simulate two users editing same paragraph and verify conflict/save/status behavior.
incentive: Collaborative docs underpin human-agent shared planning.

title: Share and permission modal for document access
intent: Add page-level access controls inspired by Docmost share and permission flows while preserving Fulcrum local-first defaults.
acceptance: Document share modal shows current access, inherited access, and public-share state.
Owner can grant view/comment/edit to user/group or project role where supported.
Public/local share links are disabled by default and require explicit confirmation.
Search, backlinks, attachments, comments, and transclusions obey access decisions.
anti_patterns: All docs globally readable by assumption
Permissions only checked in UI
Public share exposing comments or internal attachment tokens
No inherited access explanation
interactions: Open share modal, add a viewer, generate disabled-by-default share link, test unauthorized access.
critique_focus: Check if access model is understandable and enforced across every docs API.
manual_simulation: Create restricted doc, attempt open/search/backlink/attachment access as unauthorized user, then grant access and retry.
incentive: Knowledge work often contains sensitive execution context and credentials-adjacent data.

title: Public share rendering strips internal metadata
intent: If public or external sharing exists, shared documents must render safely by stripping internal comments, private metadata, and non-shareable attachment links.
acceptance: Shared render removes comment marks, internal frontmatter, private trace IDs, and unauthorized blocks.
Attachment URLs are scoped tokens, expire, and cannot access unrelated files.
Shared transclusions only render when source document is also reachable through share graph.
Share preview shows exactly what external viewer will see.
anti_patterns: Using authenticated document page as public page
Leaking comment IDs or trace IDs in HTML
Permanent attachment URLs
Rendering transcluded private pages
interactions: Create public share, preview as external viewer, inspect comments/frontmatter/attachments/transclusions.
critique_focus: Evaluate threat model for share/export surfaces before adding convenience links.
manual_simulation: Share a doc with private comments and internal attachment, open in anonymous context, verify stripped content and scoped download.
incentive: Sharing mistakes create durable data leaks.

title: Synced blocks and transclusion references
intent: Support reusable document sections that can be embedded across pages with clear source attribution, access handling, and unsync controls.
acceptance: User can insert a synced block reference to another document section.
Rendered block shows source title, link, sync status, and no-access/not-found states.
Backlinks include transclusion references distinctly from plain links.
User can unsync a block into local editable content with audit event.
anti_patterns: Copy-paste only reuse
Invisible transclusion source
Rendering private content via referenced blocks
No way to break sync intentionally
interactions: Create a source block, embed it in another doc, edit source, verify target update, then unsync target.
critique_focus: Check whether knowledge reuse is explicit and permission-safe.
manual_simulation: Embed a success criteria block into two planning docs and test updates, access denial, and unsync.
incentive: Reusable criteria and runbooks reduce drift across docs and tasks.

title: Inline subpages block with create-and-navigate flow
intent: Allow documents to show and create child pages inline so a workbench can grow naturally from a seed document into a structured plan tree.
acceptance: Editor can insert a subpages block for current document.
Block lists child docs with status, type, and updated time.
User can create a child from the block and remain in flow.
Tree sidebar and inline subpages block stay consistent after mutations.
anti_patterns: Child pages only visible in sidebar
Subpage list as static markdown
Creating child loses parent context
No empty state for docs without children
interactions: Insert subpages block, create child, return to parent, reorder child in sidebar, verify block updates.
critique_focus: Assess whether document structure is visible in the content itself when useful.
manual_simulation: Turn a meeting notes doc into a parent with decisions/tasks children and verify navigation from body and sidebar.
incentive: Supports organic breakdown from freeform docs into structured work.

title: Document import/export workflow with trace preservation
intent: Let users import/export document trees while preserving metadata, attachments, backlinks where possible, and Fulcrum workflow trace references.
acceptance: Export supports single doc and subtree with manifest, body, frontmatter, attachments, and link map.
Import preview shows conflicts, missing attachments, remapped links, and target destination.
Imported docs record source import event and preserve or remap trace references safely.
Export can be attached as artifact for review/handoff.
anti_patterns: Clipboard-only export
Import that overwrites existing docs without preview
Losing attachments/backlinks silently
Exporting internal-only metadata by default
interactions: Export a subtree, import into another project, resolve conflicts, verify links and attachments.
critique_focus: Check portability and review handoff without corrupting local knowledge graph.
manual_simulation: Round-trip a doc subtree with attachments and internal links, then compare manifest and rendered pages.
incentive: Migration, backup, and handoff need durable docs packaging.

title: Add documents to planning context from every docs surface
intent: Make W3 explicit by allowing users to assemble planning context from document list, detail, search, backlinks, and attachments without switching tools.
acceptance: Doc list, detail, search result, and backlink rows expose add-to-context actions.
Context builder shows selected docs, snippets, attachments, token/size estimates, and trace IDs.
User can start or update guided planning from the selected context bundle.
Context bundle records source document version IDs, not just current document IDs.
anti_patterns: Planning button only on one doc route
Context based on mutable latest content without version pinning
No visibility into selected context size
Copy-paste document text into prompt fields
interactions: Search docs, add two documents and one attachment to context, start planning, inspect pinned versions.
critique_focus: Verify docs genuinely feed ACP/planning rather than existing as a separate knowledge area.
manual_simulation: Build context from list and backlink surfaces, start planning, edit source doc, verify planning context remains pinned or updateable explicitly.
incentive: This is core docs-to-planning workflow value for Phase 09.6.

title: Context bundle version pinning and refresh
intent: Provide deterministic APIs for creating, refreshing, diffing, and explaining document-derived context bundles.
acceptance: Context bundle stores source type, source ID, source version, extracted summary, and inclusion reason.
Refresh operation reports changed, deleted, inaccessible, and unchanged sources.
Diff operation shows what planning context would change before accepting refresh.
Bundle assembly is deterministic and does not require embeddings or model calls.
anti_patterns: Context assembled ad hoc in UI
Mutable references with no refresh decision
Model-generated hidden summaries as only source of truth
No API for explaining why source was included
interactions: Create bundle, edit source doc, call refresh preview, accept or reject refresh.
Remove permission and verify inaccessible source handling.
critique_focus: Check determinism, traceability, and user control in context updates.
manual_simulation: Pin a context bundle, modify source doc and attachment, refresh preview, verify diff and trace metadata.
incentive: Agent planning must be reproducible and auditable.

title: Knowledge workspace home with recent, favorites, and stale docs
intent: Add a useful docs landing surface that prioritizes current work, recent edits, favorites, orphaned pages, stale decisions, and docs needing verification.
acceptance: Docs home shows recent, favorites, stale/unverified, orphaned, and project-scoped sections.
User can favorite/unfavorite docs and save filtered views.
Stale state can be derived from review date, verification date, or workflow status.
Empty states point to create/import/template actions.
anti_patterns: Docs home as only alphabetical list
No recency or ownership signals
Stale docs hidden until search
Favorites stored only in local browser state
interactions: Favorite a doc, mark another stale, create saved view, reload and verify persistence.
critique_focus: Determine whether users can resume knowledge work quickly after returning to Fulcrum.
manual_simulation: Create five docs across projects, favorite two, mark one stale, and verify landing sections guide next action.
incentive: Reduces navigation cost in large local workspaces.

title: Document verification and expiration workflow
intent: Introduce review/verification metadata for documents whose accuracy matters, inspired by Docmost page verification, tied to Fulcrum review and UAT loops.
acceptance: Document can require verification by a role/user before a date.
Verified/stale/expired badges appear on list, detail, search, and context builder.
Verification can link to review/UAT decision or manual approval comment.
Expired verified docs warn before being used as planning context.
anti_patterns: Trusting old docs by default
Verification status only in review reports
No owner for stale documents
Badges without filtering
interactions: Set verifier and expiration, approve doc, wait/simulate expiration, add to planning context and observe warning.
critique_focus: Check whether high-risk knowledge has freshness and accountability.
manual_simulation: Create a runbook with 1-day verification, approve it, simulate expiration, then use in context builder.
incentive: Prevents stale docs from steering agents and humans incorrectly.

title: Labels and document facets for knowledge organization
intent: Support document labels and facets for filtering, saved searches, and graph exploration without forcing every classification into hierarchy.
acceptance: Users can add/remove labels on document detail with permissions.
Docs list and search support label filters and saved label views.
Labels can be scoped globally or project-local.
Label changes create audit/search index updates.
anti_patterns: Only folders for organization
Freeform tags that differ by casing/spacing
Labels stored in frontmatter only
Filters that do not persist in URL/saved view
interactions: Add labels to three docs, filter list, save view, rename label and verify all docs update.
critique_focus: Check if organization scales beyond a small tree.
manual_simulation: Create labels decision/runbook/spec, filter docs, save view, then use label-filtered docs as context.
incentive: Labels improve retrieval and project knowledge hygiene.

title: Three-pane docs workbench layout
intent: Evolve docs routes into a persistent workbench with tree/sidebar, editor/detail pane, and context/details pane for comments/backlinks/history/attachments.
acceptance: Docs workbench keeps navigation tree, active document, and right-side details visible on desktop.
Right pane tabs include comments, backlinks, attachments, history, metadata, and context.
Mobile layout collapses panes predictably with no lost actions.
User can switch read/edit/history without full mental reset.
anti_patterns: Separate pages for every detail causing navigation churn
Cards nested inside cards for main layout
Right pane that duplicates main content
Mobile hiding critical actions
interactions: Open doc, edit, view comments, inspect backlinks, upload attachment, all without losing tree context.
critique_focus: Evaluate end-to-end ergonomics for repeated knowledge work, not isolated route correctness.
manual_simulation: Perform a 10-minute doc edit/review session and count navigations/context losses.
incentive: Workbench quality determines whether docs are a real operating surface.

title: Rich media blocks with resize and captions
intent: Support images, video, audio, PDF, Mermaid, Draw.io, Excalidraw, and embeds as inspectable blocks with captions and resize behavior.
acceptance: Media blocks show preview, filename/source, caption, resize controls where applicable, and open/download action.
Unsupported provider fallback is clear and preserves source URL.
Media block serialization survives save/load/export/import.
Accessibility metadata can be added for images and diagrams.
anti_patterns: Media only as plain links
Embedding iframes without provider controls
No caption or alt text
Broken block serialization in read-only renderer
interactions: Insert image, PDF, Mermaid, and external embed; add captions; resize image; save and reload.
critique_focus: Check whether technical docs can carry diagrams/evidence without leaving Fulcrum.
manual_simulation: Create an architecture note with diagram, PDF, screenshot, and embedded link; verify read/edit/export behavior.
incentive: Real planning docs are multimedia, not just markdown.

title: Automatic table of contents and heading navigation
intent: Help long planning and review documents stay scannable with a generated table of contents, active heading state, and copyable anchors.
acceptance: Long docs show a TOC derived from headings in read and edit views.
Active heading updates while scrolling.
Heading anchors are stable and copyable.
TOC ignores headings inside collapsed/private/transcluded inaccessible blocks.
anti_patterns: Manual markdown TOC
TOC that only appears in editor
Anchor IDs that change on title edit without redirects
TOC obscuring content on mobile
interactions: Create long doc with nested headings, scroll, copy heading link, rename heading and inspect anchor behavior.
critique_focus: Verify long docs remain navigable during planning and audit sessions.
manual_simulation: Write a 12-section phase spec, navigate via TOC, and open a deep link after reload.
incentive: Reduces friction in long PRDs, specs, and review reports.

title: Robust paste handling for markdown, links, files, and internal refs
intent: Make common capture flows fast by interpreting pasted markdown, files, internal doc URLs, task URLs, and screenshots into structured blocks.
acceptance: Pasted markdown becomes structured editor content.
Pasted files trigger upload with progress and attachment records.
Pasted internal doc/task/run URLs become typed references, not plain links.
User can undo paste transformation in one step.
anti_patterns: Pasting everything as plain text
Uploading files without progress/error state
Auto-transforming unknown URLs destructively
Multiple undo steps for one paste
interactions: Paste markdown table, screenshot, internal task link, and external URL into editor.
Undo each paste and verify expected content.
critique_focus: Assess capture speed from external research and local execution output.
manual_simulation: Copy content from README, paste screenshot, paste Fulcrum task URL, save, reload, and inspect block types.
incentive: Fast capture makes docs viable as the first work intake surface.

title: Document activity events for every material change
intent: Emit searchable activity/audit events for document create, edit, move, comment, resolve, attach, share, verify, context-add, and restore actions.
acceptance: Every material docs action emits a typed event with actor, source surface, document ID, version ID where relevant, and trace IDs.
Activity feed can filter document events by project/task/run/review context.
Failed permission-sensitive actions emit safe denial events without leaking private content.
Tests cover event payload contracts for each action family.
anti_patterns: Only version rows as audit trail
Unstructured event messages
No distinction between user and agent edits
Events that expose unauthorized document titles
interactions: Create, edit, comment, attach, move, restore, add-to-context, and inspect activity feed/API events.
critique_focus: Check traceability across human and agent document workflows.
manual_simulation: Perform one action from each category and query event log for exact document IDs and version IDs.
incentive: Workflow supervision depends on reliable event spine.

title: Trash and restore for documents and subtrees
intent: Provide safe deletion for documents, including subtree impact preview, restore, and permanent delete permissions.
acceptance: Delete preview shows child pages, backlinks, attachments, context bundles, and artifacts affected.
Soft-deleted docs disappear from normal tree but remain in trash view.
Restore returns doc to original parent when valid or asks for new destination.
Permanent delete requires elevated permission and extra confirmation.
anti_patterns: Immediate hard delete
Deleting parent without showing children
Restore to root without explanation
Trash inaccessible from docs workbench
interactions: Delete parent with children, view trash, restore to original parent, then try permanent delete without permission.
critique_focus: Evaluate whether users can safely manage document lifecycle in a knowledge graph.
manual_simulation: Create parent/child docs with backlinks and attachment, delete parent, restore, verify graph integrity.
incentive: Safe cleanup matters as docs grow into operational state.

title: Read-only renderer parity with editor blocks
intent: Ensure every editor block has a polished read-only rendering path for docs, shares, context previews, exports, and review evidence.
acceptance: Read-only renderer supports all blocks available in editor/slash menu.
Unsupported nodes render explicit placeholders with raw source preserved for recovery.
Renderer output is used consistently in doc detail, context preview, export, and share preview.
Snapshot tests cover representative blocks including attachments, embeds, transclusions, and comments-stripped view.
anti_patterns: Editor supports blocks that render blank in read view
Different renderers for docs and context previews
Failing closed with page crash on unknown node
Markdown fallback that loses structured metadata
interactions: Create doc with every supported block, view detail, context preview, share/export preview, and compare rendering.
critique_focus: Check parity between authoring and consumption surfaces.
manual_simulation: Generate a block zoo document, save, reload read view, export/share preview, and scan for blank or broken blocks.
